text: 《禁娼究竟为谁服务》 潘绥铭
en: "Who Does the Ban on Prostitution Actually Serve?" Suiming Pan

text: 现在最通用的卖淫定义，一般都包括4个要素：
en: The most widely used definition of prostitution generally includes four elements:

text: 1、双方自愿（否则是强奸）；
en: 1. Both parties are willing (otherwise it is rape);

text: 2、有性交合（否则仅仅是色情服务）；
en: 2. There is sexual intercourse (otherwise it is merely an erotic service);

text: 3、现金交易（给对方买房子买东西，或者给对方其他实惠或者其它利益，则不算）；
en: 3. The transaction is in cash (buying a house or goods for the other party, or giving them other tangible benefits or other interests, does not count);

text: 4、以性交合的次数或者性交持续的时间长短来计算卖淫的价格，例如“打炮”是按照性交一次来计价的，“包夜”则是按照持续时间的长短来计价。
en: 4. The price of prostitution is calculated by the number of acts of intercourse or by the duration of the sex; for example, a 'one-shot' is priced per single act of intercourse, while an 'overnight' is priced by how long it lasts.

text: （长期供养对方，或者不以“性”为计量单位的则不算）。
en: (Long-term support of the other party, or cases not measured by 'sex', do not count).

text: 但是几乎人人都知道，社会中存在着许许多多实际上的卖淫行为，都无法包括到这样一种卖淫的定义里边去。
en: But almost everyone knows that society contains many, many actual acts of prostitution that cannot be fitted into such a definition of prostitution.

text: 尤其是后两个要素，简直就是网开一面。
en: Especially the last two elements simply leave a loophole.

text: 例如男人里的隐蔽纳妾、养情妇、给情妇发红包、给情妇帮忙使其获得实惠等等行为，例如女人里的“傍大款”、“作小蜜”、“当外室”等等行为，往往都不是现金交易，也不是把性交合的次数或者时间作为计量单位。
en: For instance, among men there are concealed concubinage, keeping a mistress, giving the mistress red envelopes, and helping the mistress gain benefits; among women there are 'clinging to a rich man', 'being a little honey', 'being an outside woman', and so on — these generally involve no cash transaction, nor are they measured by the number or duration of sexual acts.

text: 这些行为，在男人那里常常是以物质利益和现实利益来代替现金；在女人那里则往往是为了获取不以金钱为表现形式的实惠。
en: These behaviours, among men, often substitute material and practical benefits for cash; among women, they are generally aimed at obtaining tangible benefits not expressed in the form of money.

text: 但是谁都知道，这种“性交易”中互换的真正价值，往往比暗娼直接卖淫的金钱收入要高得多、有用得多。
en: But everyone knows that the true value exchanged in such 'sex transactions' is often far higher and far more useful than the monetary income a secret prostitute earns from direct prostitution.

text: 虽然这些“以利获性”和“以性获利”的行为都比较间接、比较类似情人或者妾或者行贿，但是不管怎么说，上述行为实际上都是货真价实的买淫和卖淫；无论怎么开脱，也改变不了它们的这个性质。
en: Although these behaviours of 'gaining sex through benefit' and 'gaining benefit through sex' are rather indirect and rather resemble those of a lover, a concubine, or bribery, yet no matter what, the above behaviours are genuine buying and selling of sex; no excuse can alter their nature.

text: 那么社会为什么不禁止、不惩罚这些行为呢？
en: Then why does society not prohibit or punish these behaviours?

text: 绝不是仅仅因为这些行为难以发现、难以确定或者难以与通奸相区别。
en: It is absolutely not merely because these behaviours are difficult to detect, difficult to establish, or difficult to distinguish from adultery.

text: 真正的主要原因是：这样的卖淫都是卖给大老板、大富人的，至少也是以社会的上层为主要顾客。
en: The true main reason is: this kind of prostitution is sold to big bosses and the very wealthy, or at the very least takes the upper strata of society as its principal customers.

text: 之所以不把它们定成卖淫，不去禁止和惩罚，就是为了保护社会上层的切身利益。
en: The reason they are not defined as prostitution, and are neither prohibited nor punished, is precisely to protect the vital interests of the upper echelons of society.

text: 至于现在所定义的那种卖淫，则主要是以社会的中层和下层为顾客的，无论怎么禁止和惩罚，也不会伤到“上流社会”的一根毫毛，反而可以显示一下：上层人物是多么地关心平民百姓的道德完善啊。
en: As for the kind of prostitution defined at present, it mainly serves the middle and lower strata as customers; no matter how it is prohibited or punished, it will not harm a single hair of the 'upper class', and instead can show: how deeply the upper figures care about the moral improvement of ordinary people!

text: 马克思对此洞若观火，有着精辟的论述。
en: Marx saw this with perfect clarity and offered a brilliant exposition.

text: 他认为，一切法律都是为统治阶层的利益服务的，禁娼法律就能例外吗？
en: He held that all laws serve the interests of the ruling class; can the laws banning prostitution be an exception?

text: 当然，这也是有传统的，至少在中国确实如此。
en: Of course, this also has its tradition; at least this is so in China.

text: 古代的达官显贵可以买妾、买丫头来“收房”，没有人会说这是嫖娼，而那些连老婆都娶不起的穷男人，除了偷情，只能去妓院，结果被叫做嫖娼。
en: In ancient times, high officials and nobles could buy concubines and buy maidservants to 'take into the household', and no one called this visiting prostitutes; whereas poor men who could not even afford a wife, apart from having affairs, could only go to brothels, and ended up being labelled as visiting prostitutes.

text: 不过，中国古代的儒家多少还是讲一些道理的，因此各位皇上们很少搞什么禁娼。
en: However, the Confucians of ancient China still observed a degree of reason, so the various emperors rarely engaged in banning prostitution.

text: 大概他们也觉得“只许州官放火，不许百姓点灯”有些太过分了。
en: Probably they also felt that 'only the prefect may set fires, while the common people may not light lamps' was a little too much.

text: 在我们“反封建”时，是不是连这么一点人味都反掉了？
en: When we were 'anti-feudal', did we throw out even this small bit of humanity?

text: 这就是禁娼的虚伪，也是它的障眼法。
en: This is the hypocrisy of banning prostitution, and also its sleight of hand.

text: 19世纪以来，社会经常讨论该不该禁娼，或者应该如何禁娼，却偏偏不去讨论：究竟什么人才是娼。
en: Since the 19th century, society has constantly discussed whether prostitution should be banned, or how it should be banned, yet pointedly avoided discussing: exactly who counts as a prostitute.

text: 在上流社会所制造的幻象里，似乎只有那些在贫民窟附近倚门卖笑的、在平民酒吧和公众夜总会里寻找顾客的女人才是妓女，而那些高级应召女郎、那些在封闭式VIP（大人物）俱乐部里提供性服务的女人、那些大老板的“性秘书”却统统不是妓女。
en: In the illusion manufactured by the upper class, it seems only those women who lean at their doors smiling near the slums, who seek customers in working-class bars and public nightclubs, are prostitutes; whereas those high-class call girls, those women who provide sexual services in closed VIP (big-shot) clubs, and those bosses' 'sex secretaries' are none of them prostitutes.

text: 虽然有不少学者在不断地诉说着卖淫的真相，但是社会似乎总是喜欢把上层人士里的买淫说成只不过是风流韵事或者性丑闻，总是不愿意把它们跟“下九流”的平民的嫖娼等同起来。
en: Although many scholars keep telling the truth about prostitution, society always seems to prefer to describe the sex-buying of the upper class as mere romantic affairs or sex scandals, and is never willing to equate them with the prostitution of 'lowest-class' commoners.

text: 结果，在警察局里充斥着贫寒的“野鸡”，却很少能见到那些“高档货”、“专用品”或者“性的交际花”。
en: As a result, police stations are filled with impoverished 'streetwalkers', yet one rarely sees those 'high-grade goods', 'exclusive items', or 'sexual socialites'.

text: 中国目前也是大抵如此。
en: China at present is much the same.

text: 这是一种更为隐蔽的双重性道德标准。
en: This is a more concealed dual standard of sexual morality.

text: 一般人只要求法律面前人人平等，要求惩罚或者加重惩罚那些真正去找“野鸡”的上层人士。
en: Ordinary people only demand equality before the law, demanding that those upper-class people who truly go to 'streetwalkers' be punished or punished more heavily.

text: 但是这其实没有太大的意思，因为，如果社会上层和富人的各式各样的买淫活动都不算嫖娼，那么他们根本就不会犯法。
en: But this is actually of little significance, because if the various sex-buying activities of the upper class and the rich do not count as prostitution, then they simply do not break the law.

text: 即使我们真的实行“王子犯法与庶民同罪”，又能把他们怎么样？
en: Even if we truly implemented 'the prince who breaks the law is guilty as the commoner', what could we do to them?

text: 这就好比人们常说的：“偷别人一块钱叫偷，偷国家一百万叫贪污”。
en: This is like what people often say: 'stealing a yuan from another is called theft; stealing a million from the state is called embezzlement'.

text: 这两者如果在罪行性质上仍然有区别，那么贪污是永远无法防止的。
en: If these two still differ in the nature of the crime, then embezzlement can never be prevented.

text: 所以说，禁娼再彻底，最多也不过是查禁了下层的暗娼与嫖客，却永远无法禁止上层里的买淫与卖淫，反而会使上层里的狗男们有恃无恐、如鱼得水。
en: Therefore, however thorough the ban on prostitution, at most it only investigates and prohibits the lower-class secret prostitutes and their clients, yet can never prohibit the sex-buying and sex-selling within the upper class; on the contrary, it makes the scoundrel men of the upper class feel emboldened and completely at ease.

text: 在我们中国，还有另一种卖淫和嫖娼，就是“以权谋性”和“以性谋权”。
en: In our China, there is yet another kind of prostitution and whoring: 'trading power for sex' and 'trading sex for power'.

text: 早在“文革后期”，北方农村和当时的知识青年里就流传着一些俗话：“队长队长，这炕睡了那炕躺；支书支书，这家进了那家出”；还有：“入党入党，炕上一躺”、“裤带松一松，能顶半月工（分）”。
en: As early as the 'late Cultural Revolution', among the northern villages and the educated youth of the time, some folk sayings circulated: 'Team leader, team leader, sleeps on this kang then lies on that kang; Party secretary, Party secretary, enters this house and leaves that house'; and also: 'Join the Party, join the Party, one lie on the kang', 'Loosen the belt a notch, worth half a month's work points'.

text: 到了90年代，人们又形容现在的干部有“新的四项基本原则”：“吃喝基本不动，穿戴基本靠送，工资基本不用，老婆基本不碰”。
en: By the 1990s, people described today's cadres with a 'new Four Cardinal Principles': 'food and drink basically untouched, clothing basically gifted, salary basically unused, wife basically not touched'.

text: 所有这些说的都是“以权谋性”。

text: 这又必然引发“以性谋权”、“以性谋利益”和以性谋实惠”。

text: 这些现象，既不是现金交易，也不是以性交次数或者单位时间来计算价格，显然都不符合卖淫嫖娼的最后两个要素。
en: These phenomena are neither cash transactions nor priced by the number of sexual acts or by unit time, and clearly meet none of the last two elements of prostitution.

text: 因此，几乎没有任何一个有权有势而又沾花惹草的男人，曾经因此被按照嫖娼来处理，充其量也不过被当作“作风问题”、“生活问题”或者“男女关系问题”，受到一些党纪或者政纪的处分而已。
en: Therefore, hardly any powerful and philandering man has ever been dealt with for this as a patron of prostitutes; at most he is treated as a 'conduct issue', a 'lifestyle issue' or a 'relations-between-the-sexes issue', and receives only some party-disciplinary or administrative sanction.

text: 只有那些傻到去社会上找真正的暗娼的男干部，才有可能被当作嫖娼来处理。
en: Only those male cadres foolish enough to go out into society to find real secret prostitutes might possibly be dealt with as patrons of prostitutes.

text: 因此有许多男干部常常嘲笑这样的人，说他们是“碗里的肉不吃，偏要去槽里吃草”。
en: Therefore many male cadres often mock such people, saying they are 'not eating the meat in the bowl, but insisting on going to the trough to eat grass'.

text: 综上所述，至少从近代资本主义出现以后，所谓“禁娼”一直就是为了维护统治阶级的切身利益服务的，一直就是仅仅镇压穷苦的男男女女和下层老百姓，却对上层社会里的种种“性交与利益的交易”网开一面；一直就在保护有权有势的男人的“以权谋性”和欺男霸女。
en: To sum up, at least since the emergence of modern capitalism, the so-called 'ban on prostitution' has always served to protect the vital interests of the ruling class; it has always merely suppressed poor men and women and lower-class commoners, yet turned a blind eye to the various 'transactions of sex and interest' within the upper class; it has always protected the powerful men's 'trading power for sex' and their bullying and domination of others.

text: 而且，由于“以性谋权”和“以性谋实惠”都不算卖淫，所以禁娼实际上也就保护了有权有势的男人的消费对象，以便为他们“增加生产、保障供给”。

text: 难道不是吗？

text: 王宝森有情妇，已经是公开的秘密，但是他所荣获的一大堆罪名里，为什么偏偏没有嫖娼或者买淫这一条呢？
en: Wang Baosen had a mistress, which was already an open secret, yet among the great heap of charges he received, why was there precisely no charge of visiting prostitutes or buying sex?

text: 因为那只能叫做“生活腐化”，因为他可能根本就没有为此花过钱，或者没有花过自己的钱！

text: 这说明，早已千疮百孔的禁娼破船，又遇到了顶头风：一些人用公款雇“小姐”来招待上级。

en: Especially, even these warriors would never, just because they fought against the rich, go on to sympathise with the poor men and poor women defined by law as true prostitutes and clients; still less would they thereby call the entire system of banning prostitution into question.

text: 他们还会“怀才不遇”，甚至还会成为“冤魂”的。
en: They will also 'go unrecognised for their talent', and may even become 'wronged souls'.

text: 那么怎么办？
en: Then what is to be done?

text: 我对时下那些所谓“理性思维”实在是腻透了、烦透了，所以要援引1963年中国政府对待“部分禁止核试验条约”的态度：
en: I am utterly sick and tired of the so-called 'rational thinking' of the present day, so I shall cite the attitude of the Chinese government in 1963 towards the 'Partial Nuclear Test Ban Treaty':

text: 禁？
en: Ban it?

text: 好啊。
en: Fine.

text: 但是，要么全部，要么全不！
en: But it must be all or nothing!
